title: One finite presentation characterizes all base-changed etale maps by polynomial certificates
statement: Let $A_0$ be a commutative ring, $B_0,C_0$ commutative $A_0$-algebras, and $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ an $A_0$-algebra map of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] using the $B_0$-algebra structure induced by $\varphi_0$. There are integers $n,m\geq0$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_m\in B_0[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that for every commutative $A_0$-algebra $T$, the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(T\otimes_{A_0}C_0)\to\operatorname{Spec}(T\otimes_{A_0}B_0)$ induced by $\mathrm{id}_T\otimes\varphi_0$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] if and only if the coefficientwise images $f_{j,T}$ admit a polynomial inverse certificate [def-weil-pbc-etale-polynomial-certificate]. The coefficient map is $b\mapsto1\otimes b$.

proof.text: Choose a finite presentation using Algebra.Presentation.exists_presentation_fin. Transport its scalar extension to the tensor map using the tensor-map presentation construction.

Apply the conormal criterion to the resulting surjection, whose kernel is generated by its finite relations. Compose its equivalence with the polynomial inverse characterization, then rewrite the relation family.
